verdict.rationale: W&B ships an official MCP server, confirmed by a GitHub repo probe, that gives an IDE, coding assistant, or chat agent direct access to Weave traces, evaluations, runs, and artifacts. The marketing page also says coding agents like Claude Code connect through it to read production data and run evaluations. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of connecting an agent, documented tool list and setup/auth details in the evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The W\&B MCP Server gives your IDE, coding assistant, or chat agent direct access to your W\&B data and documentation
Using W&B skills and the MCP server, coding agents like Claude Code connect to Weave.
official MCP server documented at https://github.com/wandb/wandb-mcp-server
connects AI assistants to your Weights & Biases data and documentation so they can answer natural-language questions about your runs, traces, evaluations, and artifacts
